assessment: Three confirmed layout/focus defects, one separately classified authenticated mobile security-settings discoverability gap. App source unchanged.
finalFocusedCaveat: Focused-final initial register loading captures are superseded by all 8 settled registers-verified states. This is an assessment with real defects, not a blanket green visual gate.

runs.classification: Broad discovery; 16 missing patient-selection setup steps, 2 deliberately disabled ward-record navigation attempts, 2 genuinely hidden mobile MFA controls.
Superseded setup: 6 doctor-to-admin login attempts lacked explicit logout; doctor clinical forms and focus measurements retained.
Final focused interactions: 50 states, no scenario errors. Some initial register screenshots captured loading; settled register evidence below supersedes those register observations.
Superseded setup: 2 selectors matched both mounted hidden and visible register headings.
Superseded setup: 2 horizontal-pan selectors matched hidden and visible scroll containers.
Final settled mobile registers and actual horizontal pan: 8 states, no scenario errors.

findings.title: Admission form collapses behind summary on phones
findings.evidence: 342px modal, fixed 280px summary, 12px form-content width; input/tab centers hit the summary. Close button shrinks to 19.406×32px. A trial click can still find the tiny exposed edge; total pointer impossibility is not claimed.
steps: Observe identity form and summary at 390px

findings.title: Radiation-safety form exceeds mobile content width
findings.evidence: 664.781px form in 366px content container; actual horizontal scrollLeft 0→299px. Medical-record register fits 366px and does not reproduce this defect. Document scrollWidth stays 390px, so document-only overflow checks miss it.
steps: Wait for actual register heading and form
Pan its visible content container horizontally to the end

findings.title: Closing admission does not restore trigger focus
findings.evidence: Open admission, press Escape: modal closes and document.activeElement becomes BODY rather than #btn-admit-patient. Raw focused-final/results.json focus array records all six. The name input autoFocus precedes the trap useEffect capturing activeElement; the cleanup targets the prior inner input. Source explains the observed result; no fix was applied.
steps: Read activeElement and confirm dialog closed

findings.classification: confirmed mobile self-service discoverability gap; not MFA enforcement bypass
findings.title: Authenticated account-security shortcut is hidden on mobile
findings.profiles: 390×844 both themes; visible on both desktop sizes
findings.evidence: #btn-mfa-enroll exists but is hidden inside .shell__user-card at ≤768px. Source search found no alternate authenticated shell activation. Mandatory pre-login enrollment remains available through Login.tsx when mfa_enrollment_required supplies an enrollment ticket.

secondaryObservations: Fixed Sage orb overlaps the mobile radiation next-page label; the seeded next-page button is disabled, so blocked actionable pagination was not proven. It also overlaps content in some scrolling views.

Raw automatic contrast/small-target findings are retained as info. The visible admission close-target shrink is folded into UX-01. Contrast candidates require contextual verification before elevation.
Horizontal tab rails/tables and controls behind active modal backdrops are not classified as layout defects solely because geometry lists them.
